summary.text: Renea Jones is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 4, where she has served since November 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jones is the only candidate listed for the District 4 general election.

paragraphs.text: Renea Jones was born in Tennessee, and her career experience includes working as a business owner.
She was elected to the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 4 in 2024 and took office on November 5, 2024.
